revision_reason: Correct the ingestion mapping before adapter execution. With messages_use=user_only, passing a real user/assistant pair would silently discard assistant-side evidence. The official LoCoMo builder instead wraps every source utterance as a user message followed by an empty assistant placeholder.
inherited_without_change: source identity and audited file hashes
event extraction and cross-event summarization mechanisms

corrected_wma_mapping.ingest_turn: Buffer every normalized WMA turn without dropping either original role. Render attachments as caption-mediated text retaining image_id.
corrected_wma_mapping.end_session: For every buffered source utterance, call add_memory with a two-message list: a user message containing the original role label and rendered utterance plus an empty assistant placeholder. Preserve speaker_id and speaker_name from the original role. Assign a deterministic timestamp that preserves the source timestamp when strictly increasing and otherwise advances by one second. Force segmentation and extraction only on the final source utterance. Then call summarize(process_all=True) before any checkpoint snapshot or question.
corrected_wma_mapping.semantic_equivalence: This mirrors experiments/locomo/add_locomo.py, where every dialogue utterance becomes a user message plus an empty assistant placeholder under messages_use=user_only. It prevents assistant-side evidence loss while leaving upstream extraction code unchanged.
corrected_wma_mapping.timestamp_guard: The adapter must ensure strictly increasing utterance timestamps across the sample because upstream summary progress uses a greater-than timestamp cursor. Original timestamps remain in adapter trace metadata.
failure_conditions: a non-empty assistant placeholder is passed to upstream add_memory
assigned timestamps are not strictly increasing
force_segment or force_extract is set before the final utterance of a session
summarization does not finish before snapshot and checkpoint retrieval

adapter_test_obligations: both original user and original assistant utterances reach add_memory as separate user-side source records
attachment caption and image_id survive rendering
timestamps are monotonic under missing equal and out-of-order source timestamps
the final utterance alone forces segmentation and extraction
summarize uses process_all=True retrieval_scope=global time_window=3600 and top_k_seeds=15
detail and summary hits share one top_k budget with at most five summaries
reload preserves detail and summary snapshots
decision: Only the corrected per-utterance wrapper mapping is authorized for adapter implementation and fake-backend tests. No real import, dependency installation, model download, lifecycle, or numerical run is authorized.
